_meta.coverage_metric: planted hollow-receipt, out-of-schema receipt field, unsafe merge-rule target, forged/stale merge-admit, canonical-link divergence, wasteful CI publication, stale local verification, untrusted GitHub snapshot detection, procedural-core/domain-decoupling mutation detection, and frozen-treatment drift in this Skill's own refactor proof
_meta.purpose: Prove that the portable delivery method remains procedure-driven and executable while GitHub/provider/host details stay domain-decoupled, and that delivery receipts, publication, and merge controls fail closed without network access.

covers: complete receipt
missing artifact is failure rather than skip
the receipt shape is asserted by a machine schema separately from the semantic checks, so a field no semantic assertion reads cannot ride through
runnable.expected: good PASS, hollow UNMATERIALIZED FAIL, and a receipt carrying an out-of-schema field RECEIPT-SHAPE FAIL

covers: repository-scoped prefix rule
existing rule backup
unsafe repository rejection
PreToolUse and human-gate boundary warning
runnable.expected: good repo installs and checks allow; hollow target fails before Codex execution

covers: merge-admit label applied by a non-owner is refused
admit that predates the head commit is stale, not valid
nothing admitted exits 3, distinct from a layer refusing with 1
a PreToolUse hook that exits 2 refuses the run on the active host only
owner-auto lands through GraphQL pinned to expectedHeadOid and never sends authorEmail
owner identity is refused for a foreign owner, an organization, or a non-personal account
owner-auto exposes no --admin bypass
a PR whose baseRefName is not the repository's default branch is refused before merge in both preflight and land, not merged into a stacked parent branch
the post-merge readback asserts the merged PR's baseRefName is the default branch, not merely state=MERGED and mergedAt
missing or malformed baseRefName/default_branch is UNEVALUABLE, never a silent pass
runnable.expected: good PREFLIGHT GREEN; hollow blocked at L1; empty exits 3; blocking hook exits 1; owner-auto admits only an immutable personal-User owner and its merge command carries expectedHeadOid without authorEmail; non-default-base PR #50 is BLOCKED at L3 GITHUB in both preflight and land, never merged
